newsitem.title: USA: CKE Restaurants backs FY98 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: CKE Restaurants backs FY98 EPS view.

text.p: CKE Restaurants Inc said Thursday it is comfortable with the First Call consensus of earnings estimates for fiscal 1998 of $0.99 a share.
This compares with $0.73 per share earned in fiscal 1997, ended January 27, 1997.

"I was comfortable with the analysts' predictions last time I talked with them. Our trends are good," Loren Pannier, senior vice president, said after a presentation at the Piper Jaffray investors conference here.

Restaurant operator CKE said it plans to open a total of 150 new company-owned Carl's Jr restaurants over the next five years in the six Western states it is currently active in: Washington, Oregon, California, Nevada, Utah and Arizona.

According to a Piper Jaffray analyst report, CKE currently operates 415 company-owned Carl's Jr restaurants and 258 franchised or licensed units under that name. It also operates 257 other restaurants, including 107 Taco Bueno quick-service Mexican restaurants.
Pannier also said CKE wants to add 15 new franchise locations in fiscal 1998 and a total of 100 to 150 new franchised Carl's Jr restaurants over the next five years.
